text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)
A fierce run, a powerful stride... Kitasan Black threw every ounce of her current strength against the Senior Umamusume and ran her heart out to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff, pant*...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo, Kitasan! That turned into one heck of a festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san...! Thank you so much
for your hard work...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, just listen to these cheers...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This is the sound of our festival. A rush of excitement like this isn't something you find just anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you hear? Apparently this year,
apart from the Winning Live,
there's gonna be a Special Song Show."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
A special one-time-only program, huh?
They're really going all out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat?! A variety song show?!
You're trying to hype things up outside the races too?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, bring it on!
If you think you can outrun me, just try it!
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

And so, the song show hosted by the URA took place,
and the venue was buzzing with tremendous excitement.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhhhh, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOAAAAAAAHHHーーー!!
This is it, this is it! THIS is the festival
I was looking for! YAHOOOOOOOOーー!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —It's retirement.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As of today, I'm retiring from racing.
And starting next year, I will live my life as a singer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Hey, singer lady over there,
take me as your apprentice~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, re—retirement, they say!
We have to stop Golshi-san!
choice_data_list: Let's leave it be... They'll come back anyway.

text_block_list.text: Knowing how whimsical Gold Ship is, worrying about her felt like a lost cause.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes, exactly. As expected of you, Trainer.
I was just thinking the same thing.
Kitasan Black seems to be getting used to it bit by bit. And then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Kita-chan.
That was a truly wonderful Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It was an amazing festival.
Though maybe I was carried along a bit
by the excitement around me today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The old me could never have made it this far.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Because next year, I'll definitely be stronger. And an equally strong Dia-chan will be right there beside me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I know we have the power to do it. To throw the greatest festival ever."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Hey, Kita-chan, wanna do that?
You know, *that* thing we do when making a promise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That thing people do when making a promise...

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
âFor real, really really?
It's truly, really true, right?!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah, of course I promise!
We can even do a pinky swear!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: "Pinky promise"...? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you don't know it?
Look, you hook your pinkies together like this, and...

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
"Pinky swear, hope to die..." is how it goes.
It's a magic spell that means
you'll definitely keep your promise! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Pinky promise.
One more time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I promise you. I'll definitely win a GⅠ race
and head to the Arima Kinen where Kita-chan is waiting.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I promise too!
I'll become a far greater Umamusume than I am now and welcome Daiwa-chan back with open arms.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
Pinky swear, hope to die...
From now on, together forever...!
(BOOOM...)

Forged once more across time—
an unyielding promise.

"An unbreakable bond. The dreams of two who once parted—
will overlap and become one again next year."
